svg.title: Molecular context — decorative composition
svg.desc: Original composition of RDKit-derived riboflavin and CGHC peptide, plus a coordinate-derived 2FGY ribbon from anewomni-skills. Decorative placement only; no enzyme-substrate binding pose is implied. Component provenance is retained in each nested SVG.

svg.title: Riboflavin
svg.desc: Riboflavin; canonical isomeric SMILES: Cc1cc2nc3c(=O)[nH]c(=O)n(C[C@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H](O)CO)c3nc2cc1C. Generated from chemical graph; 2D depiction, not a bound pose.

svg.title: 2fgy-cartoon-chain-a
svg.desc: 2FGY coordinate-derived ribbon cartoon. HELIX/SHEET assignments from deposited PDB; C-alpha Catmull-Rom interpolation, carbonyl-derived ribbon normals, six segments per residue; fixed PCA projection. Styling widths are schematic, not atomic radii. No inferred ligand pose.

svg.title: CGHC peptide
svg.desc: CGHC peptide; canonical isomeric SMILES: N[C@@H](CS)C(=O)NCC(=O)N[C@@H](Cc1c[nH]cn1)C(=O)N[C@@H](CS)C(=O)O. Generated from chemical graph; 2D depiction, not a bound pose.
